REDRAGON H231 SCREAM – Balanced Gaming Audio with Comfort and Style 

 Immersive Sound That Keeps You in Control 

 The REDRAGON H231 SCREAM is designed to give you a clear and consistent audio experience that enhances your gameplay without overcomplicating things. Equipped with high-quality 40mm drivers, this headset delivers well-balanced stereo sound with enough depth to make explosions feel powerful while still keeping footsteps and subtle details clear. This balance is especially important for competitive gaming, where hearing small movements can make a real difference in performance.

 Whether you’re playing fast-paced FPS games, open-world adventures, or even casual online matches, the H231 provides stable and reliable sound that helps you stay focused. It’s tuned for practical use rather than exaggerated effects, making it suitable for both gaming and general multimedia like videos and music.

 Lightweight Comfort for Long Gaming Sessions 

 Comfort is one of the strongest points of the REDRAGON H231 SCREAM. The headset features a lightweight design that reduces pressure on the head, allowing you to play for extended periods without discomfort. The ear cushions are made from soft leather-style material combined with foam padding, which provides a snug fit while also helping with passive noise isolation.

 The adjustable headband ensures the headset fits securely on different head sizes without feeling too tight or too loose. This makes it a great option for gamers who spend long hours playing and need something that won’t cause fatigue. The overall design focuses on simplicity and usability, making it practical for daily use.

 Clear Communication with Noise-Reducing Microphone 

 A good microphone is essential for team-based gaming, and the H231 SCREAM delivers solid performance in this area. It comes with a flexible, adjustable boom microphone that allows you to position it exactly where you need it. The microphone is designed to reduce background noise and focus on your voice, ensuring that your teammates hear you clearly during gameplay.

 This feature is especially useful in competitive environments where communication speed and clarity can impact the outcome of a match. It’s also suitable for voice calls, online meetings, or streaming setups where consistent voice quality is important.

 Clean RGB Lighting for a Modern Gaming Look 

 The headset includes built-in RGB lighting that adds a stylish touch to your gaming setup. The lighting is subtle and clean, giving the headset a modern gaming appearance without being too distracting. It pairs well with RGB keyboards, mice, and other accessories, helping you create a unified and visually appealing setup.

 While RGB doesn’t affect performance, it plays a big role in overall presentation, especially for gamers who care about the look of their desk or streaming environment.

 Wide Compatibility Across Multiple Platforms 

 One of the key advantages of the REDRAGON H231 SCREAM is its compatibility with a wide range of devices. It works seamlessly with PCs, laptops, PlayStation consoles, and many Xbox controllers, as well as mobile devices and the Nintendo Switch. This makes it a flexible option for users who switch between platforms.

 The wired connection ensures stable performance with no latency or signal drops, which is important for gaming where timing and responsiveness matter. You simply plug it in and start using it without needing additional setup or software.

 Built for Everyday Gaming and Practical Use 

 This headset is made for users who want reliable performance without paying for unnecessary extras. It focuses on delivering the essentials: clear sound, good microphone quality, and comfortable design. This makes it ideal for entry-level to mid-range gaming setups, as well as for users who want a dependable headset for daily use.

 It’s also a strong choice for stores and sellers looking for a product that offers good value and appeals to a wide audience.

FANTECH HG11 True 7.1 Surround Sound Gaming Headset – Elevate Your Game 

 

 

 Step into the world of immersive audio and competitive gaming with the FANTECH HG11 Captain 7.1 Gaming Headset – your ultimate partner for precision, comfort, and unmatched sound clarity. Engineered for gamers who demand high-quality sound at an affordable price, the HG11 delivers a premium experience with its true 7.1 surround sound , noise-canceling microphone , and customizable RGB lighting , all packed into a durable and stylish design.

 
 🎧 Immersive 7.1 Surround Sound Technology 

 Whether you’re deep in a battle royale or sneaking through the shadows of a stealth mission, audio cues can make the difference between victory and defeat. The HG11 features advanced virtual 7.1 surround sound , powered by high-performance 50mm audio drivers that reproduce accurate directional audio with rich bass, clear mids, and crisp highs.

 Feel the depth of explosions, detect the direction of enemy footsteps, and stay fully immersed in every detail of the game world. The FANTECH HG11 turns your PC or console into a complete soundscape, helping you react faster and play smarter.

 
 🎙️ Crystal-Clear Communication with Noise-Canceling Mic 

 Team coordination is key to success in online games, and the HG11 ensures your voice is heard loud and clear. The adjustable omnidirectional microphone uses noise-canceling technology to filter out background noise, allowing seamless communication with your teammates even in noisy environments.

 With its flexible boom arm and quick mute control, it’s ideal for both in-game chat and streaming.

 
 🌈 RGB Lighting for a Bold Gaming Look 

 Gaming isn’t just about performance – it’s about style. The HG11 features RGB lighting with a futuristic glow that complements any setup. Whether you’re streaming live or just want your headset to look as good as it sounds, the customizable RGB elements give the headset a distinct gaming aesthetic.

 Pair it with the included RGB headset stand (in bundle versions) for a clean, organized, and fully illuminated desk setup.

 
 🎮 All-Day Comfort for Long Gaming Sessions 

 No matter how intense your session, the HG11 is built for endurance. The headset is designed with:

 
• 
 Soft, extra-large memory foam ear cushions for maximum comfort

• 
 Durable and adjustable metal-reinforced headband for a secure fit

• 
 Lightweight construction that reduces fatigue during extended use

 
 You can focus on your gameplay without the distraction of discomfort, making it ideal for streamers, tournament players, or long campaign marathons.

 
 🔊 In-Line Audio Controls and Vibration Feedback 

 The HG11 includes a user-friendly control panel built into the braided USB cable. With it, you can:

 
• 
 Adjust volume quickly

• 
 Mute the mic on the fly

• 
 Toggle vibration effects for deeper immersion

 
 This ensures quick access to essential audio controls without interrupting your gameplay.

 
 🔌 Plug-and-Play Compatibility 

 The FANTECH HG11 connects via USB , offering a simple plug-and-play experience for PC, laptop , and PlayStation systems. No drivers or setup are needed – just plug it in, and you’re ready to dominate the battlefield.

 Note: 7.1 surround sound features are supported on Windows PC via driver installation (included on disc or downloadable from Fantech’s website).

 
 🛡️ Built to Last 

 Fantech is known for delivering quality at an affordable price, and the HG11 is no exception. The headset’s materials are designed for durability, including:

 
• 
 Braided, tangle-resistant USB cable

• 
 Reinforced joints and flexible mic arm

• 
 Sturdy build to withstand daily use

 
 Whether you’re a casual gamer or a dedicated competitor, the HG11 is built to keep up with your intensity.

•

Finished in a delightful pink colorway, the R50i NC combines advanced acoustic engineering with modern aesthetics, delivering a premium audio experience that effortlessly complements your personal style.

 At the core of the R50i NC is an upgraded Active Noise Cancellation system that effectively filters out unwanted ambient sounds, from the hum of city traffic to the noise of a busy office, allowing you to stay fully immersed in your music, podcasts, or calls without interruption. Its IPX5 water resistance rating makes the R50i NC fully capable of handling intense workout sessions, outdoor activities, and unexpected light rain without hesitation.

 Intuitive touch controls on each earbud give you effortless command over playback, volume, ANC settings, and voice assistant activation, while the accompanying charging case extends your total listening time significantly, keeping you powered through the longest of days.

igeek-1lbrtzi.description:
Marvo HG9086W Wireless Gaming Headset — Black 

 Immerse yourself in the full depth and dimension of your gaming audio with the Marvo HG9086W Wireless Gaming Headset, a feature-rich and high-performance audio solution engineered for serious gamers who demand crystal-clear sound, reliable wireless freedom, and all-day wearing comfort in one sleek, professional package. Finished in a commanding black aesthetic, the HG9086W combines advanced acoustic engineering with versatile wireless connectivity to deliver a truly immersive gaming audio experience that keeps you fully connected to every sound, cue, and detail of your gaming environment.

 At the heart of the HG9086W is a pair of large-aperture audio drivers tuned to deliver a rich, expansive soundstage with powerful bass, clear and present mids, and detailed, accurate highs. Whether you are pinpointing the precise direction of enemy footsteps in a competitive shooter, absorbing the cinematic score of an epic RPG, or communicating clearly with teammates in a multiplayer session, the HG9086W reproduces every layer of your game's audio with impressive clarity, depth, and spatial accuracy.

 The wireless connectivity provides a stable, low-latency audio transmission that eliminates the restrictions of a wired connection, giving you the freedom to move naturally within your gaming space without compromising on audio quality or experiencing the signal dropouts that undermine immersion. The reliable 2.4GHz wireless connection ensures a consistently clean and responsive audio signal that keeps pace with the demands of fast-action gaming across a broad operational range.

 Designed for extended comfort during marathon gaming sessions, the HG9086W features generously padded over-ear cushions and an adjustable, cushioned headband that distribute weight evenly and minimize pressure on the ears and head. The lightweight construction ensures the headset remains comfortable and fatigue-free through hours of continuous wear, allowing you to stay fully focused on your gameplay without distraction.

 The retractable or flexible noise-cancelling microphone captures your voice with clarity and intelligibility while effectively filtering out background noise, ensuring your communications are always sharp and professional during team-based multiplayer sessions, streaming, and online chat. Convenient on-ear controls provide effortless management of volume levels and microphone mute functions without interrupting your gaming flow.

 A long-lasting rechargeable battery ensures extended wireless playtime on a single charge, keeping you in the game through the longest of sessions without the inconvenience of frequent recharging. Broad multi-platform compatibility makes the HG9086W a versatile headset solution across PC, gaming consoles, and compatible devices.

 A comprehensive wireless gaming audio solution for dedicated players who demand immersive sound, reliable connectivity, and all-day comfort from their headset.

 Discover a new dimension of audio freedom with the Soundcore Liberty Buds, a sophisticated pair of semi-in-ear wireless earbuds engineered to deliver premium sound quality, intelligent noise cancellation, and all-day wearing comfort in one elegantly crafted package. Presented in a vibrant, contemporary blue finish, the Liberty Buds make a confident style statement while delivering the same exceptional acoustic performance that defines the Liberty Buds lineup, making them an ideal choice for listeners who want their earbuds to reflect their personality as much as their passion for great sound.

 The semi-in-ear design sets the Liberty Buds apart from conventional in-ear earbuds, offering a lighter, more breathable fit that rests comfortably in the ear without the pressure or fatigue associated with deep-insertion tips. This open, ergonomic form factor makes them exceptionally well-suited for extended listening sessions, whether during a full workday, a long commute, or a leisurely afternoon of music and relaxation.

 Equipped with Advanced Active Noise Cancellation, the Liberty Buds intelligently identify and suppress environmental noise, creating a personal acoustic sanctuary wherever you are. The accompanying transparency mode seamlessly blends ambient sound back into your listening environment with a single tap, ensuring you remain aware of important sounds around you without fully removing your earbuds.

 Driven by high-performance acoustic drivers, the Liberty Buds produce a beautifully balanced soundstage with sparkling highs, articulate mids, and warm, natural bass. Every genre of music, every podcast, and every call is rendered with outstanding clarity and depth, reflecting Soundcore's commitment to Hi-Fi grade audio quality across all price points.

 Multi-point Bluetooth connectivity allows the Liberty Buds to stay simultaneously paired with two devices, enabling effortless switching between your smartphone and laptop without the need to manually disconnect and reconnect. Touch controls on each earbud provide intuitive management of all key functions, while the Soundcore app unlocks a full suite of customization options including EQ settings, ANC intensity adjustment, and personalized touch control mapping.

Soundcore AeroFit 2 Open-Ear Wireless Earbuds — White 

 Experience the next evolution in open-ear audio with the Soundcore AeroFit 2, a premium wireless earbud designed for active individuals who demand exceptional sound quality, a secure athletic fit, and the freedom of natural ambient awareness during every activity. Presented in a crisp, sporty white finish, the AeroFit 2 combines advanced acoustic engineering with an innovative open-ear form factor that redefines what truly comfortable, high-performance wireless audio feels like.

 The AeroFit 2 features a refined open-ear hook design that wraps securely around the outer ear without inserting into the ear canal, delivering a liberating, pressure-free listening experience that remains stable and comfortable through the most demanding physical activities. Whether you are running, cycling, training at the gym, or navigating a busy urban environment, the AeroFit 2 stays firmly in place without ever causing the discomfort or fatigue associated with traditional in-ear designs.

 Powered by large-aperture dynamic drivers, the AeroFit 2 produces an impressively rich and spacious soundstage that defies the expectations of open-ear audio. Deep, powerful bass, clear and natural mids, and detailed highs come together to create an immersive listening experience that rivals conventional sealed earbuds, all while keeping you naturally connected to the sounds of your environment for enhanced safety and situational awareness during outdoor activities.

 Engineered for an active lifestyle, the AeroFit 2 carries an IPX5 water resistance rating that provides reliable protection against sweat, splashes, and light rain, ensuring consistent performance no matter how intense your session gets. The ergonomic earhook design is available in multiple size configurations to accommodate a wide range of ear shapes, guaranteeing a personalized, secure fit for every user.

 Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity delivers a stable, low-latency wireless connection with an extended range, while multi-point pairing allows simultaneous connection to two devices for seamless switching between your phone and laptop. The Soundcore app provides access to EQ customization, control personalization, and firmware updates, putting full command of your audio experience in your hands.

 The accompanying charging case offers convenient, portable battery replenishment, extending total playtime to keep you powered through full training days, long commutes, and everything in between.

 A benchmark open-ear audio experience for active, health-conscious listeners who refuse to choose between exceptional sound and complete environmental awareness.

Alienware AW725H Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Headset – Dark Side of the Moon

 Premium Wireless Gaming Performance

 The Alienware AW725H Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Headset in Dark Side of the Moon is built for gamers who want premium sound, powerful wireless flexibility, and a modern design that matches high-end gaming setups. This headset is made for serious daily use, whether you are playing competitive games, enjoying story-driven adventures, chatting with friends, or listening to music between sessions. With its premium construction, advanced features, and iconic Alienware styling, the AW725H is designed to deliver a complete gaming audio experience.

 Tri-Mode Connectivity for Maximum Flexibility

 One of the biggest strengths of the Alienware AW725H is its tri-mode connectivity. It gives users multiple ways to connect depending on the device and the situation. You can use low-latency 2.4GHz wireless for responsive gaming, Bluetooth for mobile devices and casual everyday use, or a 3.5mm wired connection when you prefer a direct setup.

 This flexibility makes the headset ideal for gamers who switch between different platforms. It works well for desktop gaming, console gaming, mobile entertainment, and general multimedia use. Instead of buying separate headsets for different devices, the AW725H gives you one premium solution that can handle everything with ease.

 Immersive Sound That Brings Games to Life

 Sound quality is one of the most important parts of any gaming headset, and the Alienware AW725H is built to impress. It features powerful drivers that help produce rich, clear, and detailed audio across different types of content. Whether you are hearing footsteps in a competitive match, explosions in an action game, or voices in a cinematic cutscene, the headset is made to deliver a more immersive experience.

 The wide sound range helps create strong bass, balanced mids, and crisp highs, giving your games, movies, and music a more refined and premium feel. This makes the headset suitable not only for gaming but also for entertainment in general.

 Dolby Atmos for Better Positional Audio

 The Alienware AW725H supports Dolby Atmos, which adds another level of depth and realism to your listening experience. With more accurate positional sound, players can better detect where sounds are coming from during gameplay. This is especially useful in competitive games where awareness and reaction time matter.

 Dolby Atmos helps create a more spacious soundstage, allowing in-game effects to feel more natural and more precisely placed around you. Instead of flat audio, the headset delivers a more layered and realistic presentation that makes gaming more engaging and enjoyable.

 Clear Voice Communication with Retractable Microphone

 A good gaming headset needs a strong microphone, and the AW725H delivers exactly that. It includes a retractable boom microphone designed for clear communication during multiplayer games, voice chats, and online meetings. The microphone helps your voice sound cleaner and more focused, making it easier for teammates and friends to hear you.

 The retractable design is also a practical advantage. When you do not need the microphone, you can simply tuck it away to keep the headset looking clean and streamlined. This makes the AW725H a good choice not just for gaming, but also for general everyday use.

 Long Battery Life for Extended Sessions

 Battery life is one of the standout features of the Alienware AW725H. It is designed for users who spend long hours gaming or listening without wanting to recharge constantly. With extended battery performance, the headset can handle long gaming sessions, work calls, entertainment, and daily use more comfortably.

 This makes it a strong option for gamers who want less interruption and more freedom. Instead of worrying about charging every day, you can focus on your games and enjoy a more reliable wireless experience.

igeek-1hjrj68.description:
LEGENDARY GEAR. LEGENDARY PLAY.

 G522 LIGHTSPEED is designed for extensive play and unrivaled performance—as part of the legendary G5 Series. With dynamic LIGHTSYNC RGB lighting, immersive sound, and the best microphone in gaming, G522 makes every play, achievement, and breakthrough in your game feel truly legendary.

 

 
 
 
 

 
 SYNCHRONIZED PRO-G AUDIO DRIVERS

 Whether you’re sneaking past guards, unlocking legendary loot, or just vibing out in an RPG, every sound matters. Capture the full soundscape of your game with low-profile synchronized audio.

 
 

 
 SPATIAL ACCURACY

 Logitech G522 LIGHTSPEED features spatial audio that allows you to pinpoint the location of in-game audio cues, from gunfire and footsteps to lurking enemies and hidden loot. Gain a competitive advantage in ranked play or become more immersed in your favorite single-player games with precise directional audio.

 
 

 
 AUDIO LAYERS

 When listening to game audio, many different sound layers play at the same time, like music, sound effects, dialog, voice chat, and more. PRO-G drivers are built to reproduce audio from multiple sound layers simultaneously so you hear each sound layer as clearly as possible and enjoy a soundtrack while you game.

 
 
 Additional Features

 

 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 BETTER BASS

 
 
 Sound waves bounce off any surface they come in contact with and with each bounce the sound changes. Our acoustic modules are completely isolated from other components, which gives us more control to increase the bass output for a richer audio experience.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 BEST-IN-CLASS MICROPHONE

 
 
 Your game does the talking for you. But when you need to rally the squad or announce your latest legendary move, make every word crystal clear with best in class full bandwidth 48 kHz voice clarity and BLUE VO!CE tech.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 BROADCAST QUALITY MIC

 
 
 48 kHz is the highest bandwidth mic you can get in a gaming headset and is only matched by the likes of the ASTRO A50 and A50 X. More bandwidth means more data and more data means more clarity, so you always come through loud and clear on comms. The only downside is always being asked “wait, what mic are you using?”

 
 
 

 
 
 
 BLUE VO!CE CUSTOMIZATION

 
 
 BLUE VO!CE gives you deep voice customization and tuning options from Input Gain, to Mic EQ, and SIGNAL CLEANUP, so you can tailor your sound exactly the way you want to. When you find your winning combo, use the SAMPLER TOOL to hear how it all came together.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 REMOVABLE MIC WITH MUTE LED

 
 
 The 48 kHz boom mic is fully removable. When you don’t need your mic, you can easily pop it out to pack your headset or take a quick snack or drink break. The red LED on the tip of the mic lets you know when you’re muted, so you don’t have to worry about distracting your squad.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 LIGHTWEIGHT COMFORT

 
 
 Seriously comfortable design with dual-layers of memory foam to cushion and cool, softer and more durable fabrics, a larger and more natural ear cup shape, and a suspension band with ridges for better airflow, all at a comfortably light 290g.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 LIGHTSPEED TRI-MODE CONNECTIVITY

 
 
 Connect in 3 different ways with pro-grade LIGHTSPEED wireless via G522’s included LIGHTSPEED dongle, Bluetooth wireless for even more connection options, and USB-C wired with audio and data passthrough.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 DYNAMIC LIGHTSYNC RGB

 
 
 G522 LIGHTSPEED’s unmistakable, recessed, LIGHTSYNC RGB has 8 total customizable lighting zones and 16.8 million colors to choose from. Try out different lighting effects and patterns to personalize your look for any game, outfit, gaming setup, or vibe.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 CUSTOMIZATION SOFTWARE

 
 
 G HUB and G MOBILE bring out the best in your Logitech G gear. Download on Windows, macOS, or mobile to update your gear, adjust settings, synchronize lights, and personalize until it's truly yours.

Compact and Reliable Performance with the Razer Barracuda Wireless & Bluetooth Multi-Platform Gaming Headset - White

 Conquer any gaming setup or mobile adventure with the Razer Barracuda Wireless & Bluetooth Multi-Platform Gaming Headset - White —a hybrid headset designed for seamless audio across platforms. Its 50mm TriForce drivers deliver rich, layered sound, enhanced by THX Spatial Audio for immersive 3D positioning, perfect for pinpointing enemies or enjoying movies. Dual beamforming noise-cancelling mics ensure clear voice pickup for team chats or calls, while SmartSwitch dual-wireless (HyperSpeed 2.4GHz and Bluetooth 5.2) toggles effortlessly between gaming and mobile modes. At 300g with plush FlowKnit earpads, it offers all-day comfort, and its 40-hour battery life keeps you powered for days. In a sleek Mercury White finish, this headset blends bold style with versatile performance—ideal for gamers who play everywhere and want to stand out.

 
 Key Features

 
• 
 50mm TriForce Drivers: Splits audio into highs, mids, and lows for crisp, balanced sound—THX Spatial Audio creates a wide, directional soundstage for competitive gaming or cinematic music playback.

• 
 Dual Beamforming Noise-Cancelling Mics: Integrated mics capture clear vocals with minimal background noise—great for Discord calls or streaming, though less robust in loud environments than boom mics.

• 
 SmartSwitch Dual Wireless: Connects to 2.4GHz for lag-free gaming and Bluetooth 5.2 for mobile—double-tap to switch modes, with auto-switching for calls and ‘Do Not Disturb’ via Razer Audio App.

• 
 40-Hour Battery Life: USB-C charging delivers up to 40 hours (tested at ~60 hours at moderate volume)—supports wired 3.5mm use when powered off, ensuring uninterrupted audio for travel or play.

• 
 Lightweight Comfort Design: 300g frame with breathable FlowKnit memory foam and leatherette earpads—swiveling cups and a padded headband stay comfy for hours, with passive isolation for noisy settings.

• 
 Multi-Platform Versatility: Works with PC, PS5, Switch, and mobile via USB-C dongle, Bluetooth, or 3.5mm cable—low-latency 2.4GHz excels for gaming, while Bluetooth suits casual smartphone use.

• 
 Mercury White Aesthetic: Glossy White earcups with Black accents (sliders, padding)—adds a clean, modern vibe to light-themed desks, doubling as stylish headphones for public outings.

 Experience 360 Spatial Sound for gaming

 The Meta Quest 3 is the ultimate in consumer virtual reality. This wireless headset lets you immerse yourself in captivating virtual worlds with unrivalled ease. Whether you want to explore virtual environments, play exciting games or watch 360-degree videos, the Meta Quest 3 is there for you.

Immerse yourself in fantastic worlds, battle formidable enemies, solve complex puzzles and take part in epic adventures. Whether you're a passionate gamer or a fan of new experiences , the Meta Quest 3 will keep you entertained.

Immerse yourself in colourful worlds, discover breathtaking landscapes and interact with virtual characters more realistically than ever before.

 The Meta Quest 3 is designed for comfort. Its lightweight, ergonomic design means it can be worn for long periods without discomfort. Adjustable straps ensure a perfect fit, while built-in ventilation prevents heat build-up. So you can enjoy your virtual reality experience for hours without feeling tired.

Meta says the addition of a d epth sensor will allow Quest 3 to capture a more accurate representation of your gaming space while intelligently understanding and reacting to objects in your physical space.
